column1: # SUID/SGID binaries that a stock Linux install actually ships.
# Anything in a -perm -4000 / -2000 hunt that is NOT in here and NOT in gtfobins.tsv gets
# flagged as unknown, so keep this file honest: add the ones your distro really ships
# (pacman -Qo <path> / dpkg -S <path> will tell you which package owns it).
# bits      suid | sgid | suid,sgid | any        ("any" = the distro varies, do not compare)
# severity  OK | INFO | NOTICE | WARN | CRITICAL  (default OK)
